title: Design System: Keys Keeper native macOS companion

components.name: Activity panel — browser approximation
components.description: Illustrates native panel width, inset, and rounding. Browser Canvas is an opaque stand-in for AppKit popover material; native transparency and shadow are not reproduced. CSS pixels illustrate native points at a 1:1 preview scale. The native SF Symbol is omitted.

components.name: Activity metric — browser approximation
components.description: Static sample of the baseline-aligned attributed count. The number is an illustrative value. The browser system font cannot guarantee SwiftUI rounded metrics; native .rounded and .monospacedDigit() remain authoritative.

components.css: .ds-metric { width: 316px; max-width: 100%; font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; color: CanvasText; color-scheme: light dark; } .ds-metric-line { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; } .ds-metric-label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-metric-value { font-family: ui-rounded, -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 30px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-metric-period { margin-top: 2px; color: GrayText; font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Statistic row — browser approximation
components.description: Illustrates the repeated row inset and trailing monospaced count using a static sample. Browser GrayText approximates SwiftUI secondary foreground; the optional native terminal SF Symbol is omitted.
components.css: .ds-statistic { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; width: 316px; max-width: 100%; padding: 5px 0; color: CanvasText; font: 13px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; color-scheme: light dark; } .ds-statistic-label { color: GrayText; } .ds-statistic-value { font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Vault toggle — browser approximation
components.description: Browser-native button stand-in for SwiftUI borderedProminent with a copper tint request. The browser bezel, hover/focus/pressed states, and text are illustrative; they are not AppKit tokens. The native icon is omitted. This specimen does not open a vault. Native behavior changes Open to Hide, preserves the valid existing page, and disables the action while opening.

narrative.overview:
This is a native extension of the incumbent Keys Keeper identity. Copper and the key symbol supply product recognition; AppKit material, system text, and native controls supply the surrounding visual language. The direction is descriptive of the built utility, with no new brand metaphor.

The panel uses compact, readable groups to show attributed activity and provide access to the existing vault window. It separates totals, unknown sources, and failures without decorative cards or marketing content. Those choices describe this native surface and do not prescribe a redesign of the web admin.
keyCharacteristics: Copper identity within native macOS materials and controls.
A prominent count with aligned, quieter supporting statistics.
One primary window action and lightweight utility actions.
Explicit loading, unavailable, empty, and incomplete states.

rules.name: The Native Resolution Rule
rules.body: Preserve semantic foregrounds, material, and native button styles; a color sampled from one screenshot is not a reusable palette token.

rules.name: The Stable Digits Rule
rules.body: Keep metric and row values monospaced so a refresh changes the number without changing its digit rhythm.

rules.name: The Platform Depth Rule
rules.body: Let AppKit resolve material and elevation for the current appearance; do not turn the screenshot's gray backing or shadow into a fixed surface recipe.

dos: Do preserve the copper accent and native key-symbol identity.
Do use macOS semantic text, material, controls, and focus behavior for this companion.
Do keep values aligned with monospaced digits and retain distinct labels for attributed, unknown, total, and failed activity.
Do retain visible feedback for loading, unavailable, empty, and incomplete statistics.
Do preserve the current page and unfinished input when hiding and showing the existing valid vault window.
donts: Don't replace native materials, shadow, or control states with screenshot-derived fixed CSS values.
Don't treat the sidecar's HTML/CSS illustrations as a web design system or evidence of native interaction testing.
Don't imply that an unavailable count is zero or that an unknown caller has an identified agent.
Don't add marketing ornament, a new brand metaphor, or competing primary actions to this compact activity panel.
Don't generalize this panel's fixed geometry into a rule for the web admin or other product surfaces.
